summary: Welcome to Dinosaur Park! Explore the Jurassic in a fun dinosaur game
description:
Travel back in time to the world of the dinosaurs. From the Triassic, to the Jurassic, and the Cretaceous – Dinosaur Park, a camp ground of dinosaurs to play and explore!

Take control of the T-Rex, the Triceratops, the Spinosaurus or 10 other dinosaurs in the camp of Dino Park, Eat the food, collect the stars, interact with the environment and other dinosaurs. Simple controls lets you pick up and play. Lots of fun mini games along the way!

FEATURES:
- Over 13 Dinosaurs to take control in the dinosaur park 
- Simple and guided game-play. anyone can pick up and play the dinosaur game
- Mini games including balloon pop, fossil bones puzzles and Match the eggs
- Information on each dinosaur for an Jurassic world educational experience
- Enter the camp during the cretaceous period and complete all the levels!
 
You're about to head off on an amazing journey. It's a trip through time. back into the world of the dinosaurs. Be careful! This is not an easy journey. Danger lurks around every corner. Some of these dinosaurs are meat-eaters that can tear you apart with their teeth and claws. Others are smaller meat-eaters that work in teams to chase down their prey. Thankfully many of the dinosaurs are gentle plant eaters, although you don't want to make them upset because some of them are so huge that they could crush you with a single step. Always be alert, watch your back and try to keep your distance from the dinosaurs. If you can remember these simple rules, this journey will be a marvellous trip into a lost world that existed millions of years in the past.

Privacy Information:
